description: Guidance for writing each section of a 10-section business plan grounded in prior workflow steps.

sections.title: Executive Summary
sections.purpose: Provide a concise overview of the business, value proposition, target market, and strategic direction.
keyQuestions: What problem does the business solve?
Who is the primary customer?
What is the unique value proposition?
What are the top 3 strategic priorities?
antiHallucinationRules: Do not invent revenue figures not supported by BMC or SWOT
Reference the selected value proposition by name
Only claim SDG alignment supported by prior mapping

sections.title: Market Opportunity
sections.purpose: Describe the market need, size, trends, and why now is the right time.
keyQuestions: Who experiences the problem most acutely?
What market trends support this opportunity?
What is the competitive landscape?
antiHallucinationRules: Mark market size estimates as [INFERRED] unless sourced from user context
Align customer segments with BMC customer_segments block
Do not contradict SWOT opportunities or threats

sections.title: Business Model Overview
sections.purpose: Summarize how the business creates, delivers, and captures value using BMC blocks.
keyQuestions: How does each BMC block contribute to the model?
What are the key partnerships and resources?
How does revenue flow?
antiHallucinationRules: Every BMC block claim must map to stored BMC content
Cite block names explicitly (e.g., Key Partners, Revenue Streams)
Do not add partners or channels not in the BMC

sections.title: Product or Service Description
sections.purpose: Explain the offering, features, and differentiation.
keyQuestions: What is the core product or service?
What pain points does it relieve?
What makes it different from alternatives?
antiHallucinationRules: Ground features in value_propositions BMC block
Align with selected SWOT strengths
Do not invent product capabilities not implied by story or BMC

sections.title: Customer & Marketing Strategy
sections.purpose: Define target customers, relationships, channels, and go-to-market approach.
keyQuestions: Who are the primary customer segments?
How will you reach and retain them?
What is the customer relationship model?
antiHallucinationRules: Use BMC customer_segments, channels, and customer_relationships blocks
Match focus areas from dilemma triangle workflow
Do not contradict tensions or dilemmas resolved earlier

sections.title: Operations Plan
sections.purpose: Describe key activities, resources, and operational delivery model.
keyQuestions: What are the critical activities?
What resources are required?
How is quality and delivery ensured?
antiHallucinationRules: Ground in BMC key_activities and key_resources blocks
Address operational risks from issues/tensions steps
Do not invent facilities or headcount without marking [INFERRED]

sections.title: Financial & Sustainability Outlook
sections.purpose: Outline revenue model, cost structure, and financial sustainability.
keyQuestions: What are the primary revenue streams?
What are the major cost drivers?
How does the model remain financially sustainable?
antiHallucinationRules: Use BMC revenue_streams and cost_structure blocks as source of truth
Mark financial projections as [INFERRED] unless user provided numbers
Align with SWOT financial opportunities and threats

sections.title: Key Risks & Mitigation Strategies
sections.purpose: Identify major risks and concrete mitigation approaches.
keyQuestions: What are the top business risks?
How will each risk be mitigated?
What trade-offs remain unresolved?
antiHallucinationRules: Draw risks from SWOT weaknesses and threats
Reference ranked dilemmas and tensions from prior steps
Do not dismiss risks flagged in critique agent warnings

sections.title: SDG Alignment & Impact
sections.purpose: Connect the business model to UN SDGs with evidence-based claims.
keyQuestions: Which SDGs does the business directly support?
What is the evidence for each alignment?
What social/environmental costs and benefits exist?
antiHallucinationRules: Only claim strong SDG alignment with evidence from SDG mapping or BMC impact blocks
Use social_environmental_cost and social_environmental_benefit BMC blocks
Avoid greenwashing — mark inferred alignments as [INFERRED]

sections.title: Conclusion & Next Steps
sections.purpose: Summarize strategic direction and immediate actionable next steps.
keyQuestions: What is the strategic summary?
What are the top 3 next steps?
What milestones should be tracked?
antiHallucinationRules: Next steps must follow logically from prior sections
Do not introduce new business lines or markets not discussed earlier
Reiterate selected value proposition and primary SDG focus
